{{Infobox character|name=Garron, the Binder|image=Portrait garron.jpg|house=[[House Stormrider]]|role=The sitting uniter|age=~64|kin=[[Una]] (daughter)|words=Many horses, one hoof.|seat=[[the Hub]]}}
'''Garron, the Binder''' united three generations of division on the northern plains — not by defeating the factions but by making them no longer want to be factions. He is genuinely loved, genuinely fair, and dying.

He speaks little; that is the point. When he truly wants to unite two who disagree, he says nothing — stands physically between them and waits, and the silence does the work. He never touches weapons. Lately, when he thinks himself unwatched, he places his hand flat against the ground of [[the Hub]], as if listening for something beneath it.

{{Quote|I did not bind you together. I only stood there until you did it yourselves.|Garron, the Binder}}
